subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` ingest arbitrary JSONL logs, and under what redaction and field-selection contract, or should JSONL recall stay in QMD/session-memory/converter/plugin workflows?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but admitting arbitrary raw logs into builtin memory changes what sensitive data may be embedded, stored, watched, and sent to embedding providers.

options.title: Define safe builtin JSONL ingestion
options.body: Approve builtin JSONL support only with explicit record/field selection, redaction, line mapping, watcher, `memory_get`, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Document an external workflow
options.body: Keep builtin extra paths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory export, or a converter/plugin as the supported raw-log path.

options.title: Defer for plugin API design
options.body: Keep the issue open as a design item only if maintainers identify a missing plugin or memory API seam needed before external implementation is safe.

recommendation.title: Define safe builtin JSONL ingestion
recommendation.body: Approve builtin JSONL support only with explicit record/field selection, redaction, line mapping, watcher, `memory_get`, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The live issue discussion and recent memory host SDK history make `steipete` the best available routing owner for the product/security choice.
